name: Martian Gain (VST3)
description: A free Windows VST3 multiband distortion. One to five bands, each running its own algorithm out of sixteen — from a tube that flatters everything to a fold-crush-clip cascade with no musical justification at all — with a limiter on every band and a measured gain match, so turning DRIVE up changes what a band sounds like without changing how loud it is. Then the front panel comes off: underneath is a patch bay where any band's audio or envelope can drive any other band's knobs, or move the crossovers themselves.
note: Windows VST3 · build 260827.2 · free download · 18-page manual included.
